description: Implementation of ArcBufferWriter, a buffer writer utilizing pooled pages for creating ReadOnlySequence<byte> instances with support for buffer management, slicing, and paging.

classes.name: ArcBufferWriter
classes.description: A buffer writer implementation using pooled pages, optimized for creating ReadOnlySequence<byte> instances. Supports writing, slicing, and buffer management.

classes.name: ArcBufferPage
classes.description: Represents a page of byte data with reference counting and versioning for safe pooling and reuse.

classes.name: ArcBufferPagePool
classes.description: Pool managing ArcBufferPage instances, segregating small and large pages for reuse.

classes.name: ArcBuffer
classes.description: A slice of a sequence of pages representing a portion of the buffer with methods for copying, slicing, and enumeration.

methods.name: ArcBufferWriter
methods.description: Constructors and buffer management methods including Dispose, Reset, AdvanceWriter, GetMemory, GetSpan, and buffer-specific operations.

methods.name: ArcBuffer.PageSegmentEnumerator
methods.description: Enumerator over page segments within an ArcBuffer.

methods.name: ArcBuffer.PageEnumerator
methods.description: Enumerator over pages in an ArcBuffer.

methods.name: ArcBuffer.SpanEnumerator
methods.description: Enumerator over spans in an ArcBuffer.

methods.name: ArcBuffer.MemoryEnumerator
methods.description: Enumerator over read-only memory segments in an ArcBuffer.

methods.name: ArcBuffer.ArraySegmentEnumerator
methods.description: Enumerator over array segments in an ArcBuffer.

methods.name: ArcBuffer.Pin
methods.description: Pinning method for pages to prevent them from being returned to the pool.

methods.name: ArcBuffer.Unpin
methods.description: Unpin pages to allow them to be returned to the pool.

methods.name: ArcBuffer.CheckValidity
methods.description: Validates the token against the page's current version.

methods.name: ArcBuffer.Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of buffer slices, unpinning pages.
